title: AIRA - Connect engineer
description:
Job Description – AIRA Connect Engineer

About AIRA Connect

AIRA Connect is the signaling and real-time communications backbone of the AIRA HR interview automation ecosystem. It powers WebRTC-based audio/video sessions between candidates, recruiters, and AI interview bots, stitching together TURN services, role-gated JWT flows, and low-latency relay pipelines (TTS/STT orchestration). We're scaling this into a robust, enterprise-grade platform.

Role Overview

We're looking for an AIRA Connect Engineer to design, build, and optimize the signaling and media orchestration stack that sits at the heart of the AIRA interview experience. This role sits at the intersection of real-time media engineering, backend APIs, and distributed systems, with accountability for performance, scalability, and developer ergonomics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, develop, and maintain the Node.js signaling server (Express + Socket.IO) with JWT-gated roles (candidate, recruiter, bot, sentinel).

  • Integrate and optimize TURN/ICE credential provisioning, ensuring secure and high-availability media paths across geographies.

  • Enhance WebRTC orchestration scripts (Python + Node) to support candidate-only video capture, dynamic role joining, and multi-participant session stability.

  • Drive low-latency audio relay integration with ElevenLabs (TTS) and Deepgram (STT), leveraging ffmpeg slicing for sub-second response loops.

  • Implement robust logging, monitoring, and analytics pipelines to capture per-session media stats, latency insights, and CPU/memory utilization.

  • Partner with ATS integration services, calendar schedulers, and reporting pipelines to ensure end-to-end reliability of interview scheduling and execution.

  • Continuously optimize for performance: lower audio/video lag, reduce CPU load, and scale concurrent sessions across EC2 instances.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong proficiency in Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, and WebRTC internals (ICE, STUN/TURN, SDP, codecs).

  • Experience with real-time audio/video pipelines, including ffmpeg, PCM stream manipulation, and live transcription/synthesis.

  • Working knowledge of Python orchestration scripts in a production media environment.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS EC2, systemd services, load balancing).

  • Solid grasp of authentication & security flows (JWT, HMAC secrets, TLS).

  • Proficiency in debugging distributed, real-time systems using logs, metrics, and structured monitoring.

Nice-to-Have

  • Hands-on with AI-driven media: TTS/STT engines (ElevenLabs, Deepgram, Whisper, etc.).

  • Experience with database persistence layers (MySQL/MariaDB) and structured logging/reporting.

  • Exposure to ATS platforms (JobDiva, Greenhouse, etc.) and third-party calendar APIs (Zoom, Google Calendar).

  • Familiarity with insightface/face recognition pipelines for session analysis.

Success Metrics

  • Sub-second audio relay response times across interviews.

  • High session reliability (>99.9% uptime for candidate/recruiter joins).

  • Efficient CPU/memory footprint on EC2 nodes under load.

  • Clear, actionable analytics from logging and monitoring pipelines.

Why Join Us

At AIRA, you'll be building the future of AI-driven hiring: interviews where bots converse naturally, recruiters get high-resolution insights, and candidates experience a seamless process. If you're excited by real-time systems, edge AI, and the thrill of scaling mission-critical infrastructure, this role is your launchpad.
